test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Convert to active voice:**

A letter is written to the editor by the citizen every week.

options.text: The editor writes a letter to the citizen every week.
The citizen writes a letter to the editor every week.
The editor wrote a letter weekly.
The citizen has been writing weekly letters to the editor.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "A letter is written to the editor by the citizen every week."
 
• To convert to active voice: The subject "the citizen" should be placed at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Change the passive verb "is written" to the active form "writes."
 
• Ensure the remaining sentence structure stays consistent, with the object "a letter" and "to the editor every week" retained in their respective positions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The citizen writes a letter to the editor every week."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The editor writes a letter to the citizen every week." – Incorrect subject-object placement.
 
• **Option 3: **"The editor wrote a letter weekly." – Incorrect tense and subject-object placement.
 
• **Option 4: **"The citizen has been writing weekly letters to the editor." – Incorrect tense.
